firstFrameImage.label: First frame image
firstFrameImage.description: Image used as the opening frame; 720p or higher and a 16:9 or 9:16 frame is recommended.

lastFrameImage.label: Last frame image
lastFrameImage.description: Image used as the closing frame; must be provided together with the first frame image.

referenceImages.label: Reference images
referenceImages.description: Up to 3 images that keep the subject appearance; duration is fixed at 8 seconds when used.

durationSeconds.label: Duration
durationSeconds.description: Must be 8 seconds for 1080p, 4K, or reference-image inputs.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: 1080p and 4K are only available with an 8 second duration.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for repeat generation; output is not guaranteed to be identical.
